note: Machine-readable source for the fairness-gender-age gate (scripts/fairness_gate.py; verify_10 Tier 3). The gate enforces max-min micro-CER disparity <= budget_pts across subgroups with n >= n_floor; smaller subgroups are printed but NOT gated, because EVAL.md flags female/teens/forties as directional-not-conclusive. With n_floor=50 the age axis is gated (twenties vs thirties -> 4.89 pts) and the gender axis is currently UNDERPOWERED (only male has n>=50) so it is reported but not gated until more balanced data exists. budget_pts=10.0 is PROVISIONAL (~2x the current adequately-powered disparity of 4.89 pts) and owner-tunable; it is to be re-derived from CORDI per-dialect metadata (owner-gated: cordi-dialect-fairness).
